caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “Coherency” displays performance comparisons across four different prompts (V1, V2, V3, V4) of the HDM model in terms of coherence, as evaluated by the GEMBA-SQM metric. The horizontal axis lists the four prompt variants in order: V1, V2, V3, and V4. The vertical axis represents the coherence score, ranging from 86 to 100, with major tick marks at intervals of 2 units. Each bar corresponds to one prompt variant and is color-coded: V1 is dark blue (score: 93.69), V2 is orange (score: 93.8), V3 is green (score: 94.5), and V4 is purple (score: 91.1). The bars are not sorted by value but appear in the sequence of the prompt variants. V3 achieves the highest coherence score (94.5), while V4 has the lowest (91.1). The chart includes horizontal dashed gridlines to aid in reading the scores, and each bar is labeled with its exact numerical value at the top. The overall visual trend indicates that V3 outperforms the others in coherence, followed closely by V2 and V1, with V4 lagging behind.
